text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: Are you feeling tired, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me.
I won't be worn out by something of this level.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, we'll discuss the issues from this race
once we're back at the academy... Now go.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will... head back after cooling down.
I'll catch up shortly, so go ahead back to the academy without me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She claims she isn't tired,
but she certainly doesn't look it.
It might be best to reconsider her race schedule.
